{{short description|Polish mathematician}}
'''Aleksander Axer''' (10 October 1880 – 4 October  1948) was a Polish mathematician from [[Przemyśl]] who introduced [[Axer's theorem]].<ref>{{cite web|last1=Piotrowski|first1=Walerian|title=Aleksander Axer (1880-1948) i Henryk Lauer (1890-1939)|url=https://duch.mimuw.edu.pl/~ptm/wydawnictwa/index.php/wiadomosci-matematyczne/article/download/4197/3792|website=Roczniki Polskiego Towarzystwa Matematycznego Seria II: Wiadomości Matematyczne|accessdate=19 August 2017|date=1987|language=pl|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170820033759/https://duch.mimuw.edu.pl/~ptm/wydawnictwa/index.php/wiadomosci-matematyczne/article/download/4197/3792|archive-date=20 August 2017|url-status=dead}}</ref>

He died suddenly of complications from [[pharyngitis]] in [[Zurich]], shortly before his 68th birthday.<ref>{{cite journal|last1=Andrzejewski|first1=Zenon|title=Dr Aleksander Axer (1880 – 1948)|url=http://www.pbp.webd.pl/tkop/axeraleks.htm|accessdate=19 August 2017|journal=Rocznik Przemyski|date=2004|language=pl}}</ref>
